senses.gloss: m. pl. (used as sing.) (שְׁלָה) tail, end.
units: <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 20:16">Targ. II Chr. XX, 16</cite>.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 115a">Yeb. 115ᵃ</cite> <he>בש׳ הלוליה</he> (not <he>הלולי</he>) at the end of his wedding (when he was left alone with his bride).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 64a">B. Mets. 64ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01983"><he>פִּרְקָא</he></cite>; a. e.
